reviews.title: Very outdated aircraft
reviews.text: Zero food/drink service, not even coffee/juice and snack. I've been on different LCC before, everyone of them provided at least drink and snack. 5 hours evening flight, they had nothing! Aircraaft(Boeing 777) was our flightand it has ZERO infotainment. You have no idea where, how much flight left, you have to take a guess, bring your own movies. Also seats didn't have charging plugs. It's 2023, I can't charge my phone? But the worst of all... seats were so old, it had almost zero cushion. It was like sitting on a hard chair. After 5+ hours from Seoul to Bangkok, I lost all feelings in my butt. There were numb. I aslo over heard another passenger complaint about uncomfortable seat.
reviews.author: Chris K

reviews.title: Cramped terribly rude abusive staff
reviews.text: Avoid this airline at all cost, the smallest seats ive ever seen, no infight entertainment, nothing no drinks, not even a blanket or pillow.. have to beg for water.. will never fly this airline again
reviews.author: Stevie D

reviews.title: Do not fly this airline
reviews.text: Because there was no direct flight from N America to BKI (Kota Kinabalu), Malaysia, we (me and my wife) booked Jin Air flight after stopover at Incheon. That was a huge mistake. When checking in at the gate counter, I was told we had to buy new tickets because of name mismatch. The gate agent said I made a mistake not providing sour full names when making the reservation. That was simply not true. On their website, they asked for my last and first name while our full names, including middle name, were on the passports. The problem was resolved only after talking to the airport manager and I suggest him to make a recommendation for the change in their webpage reservation screen. A bigger problem was hidden though, Unknown to my knowledge, the return flight from BKI to ICN originally reserved was cancelled and we were assigned to the flight on the following day's flight. I discovered this change while in Kota Kinabalu and tried to be on the flight one day ahead. The reason? To catch the return flight from Incheon to Seattle. There was no email address I could use to contact the customer service. Only phone # provided was a Korean number and they don't provide a local Jin Air office number either. To make a long story short, I was unable to be on the flight I wanted and had to take the changed flight which means I have to pay additional $642 change of flight fee of to Air Canada. I understand Jin Air is a LCC airline, but that does not mean they can change the flight schedule as they see fits. They do not care for their customers, only thing they care for is their bottom line. Try to avoid this airline if you are not lucky enough living in Korea or having one of Korean mobile phone. They are not ready to serve international flight!
reviews.author: Hyun P

reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: Was travelling with a toddler and accidentally left a jacket on the plane. Couldnt get through the phone line due to language barrier only korean… Wrote via email to notify them that i have left something and they seamlessly arranged for me to collect it during check in on my return flight. Kudos and thanks to the team :)
reviews.author: Liew S

reviews.title: Incredible Customer Service in Seoul - Fantastic Flight
reviews.text: We flew Jin Air in 2017 from Seoul to Osaka and had never heard of this airline when booking. The price was lower than anything we had seen so we figured why not and booked it. Anyway, after a short stay in Seoul, we got on the train to ICN and seriously underestimated how long it took to get to the airport from the city and arrived at the check-in counter about 20 minutes before our flight was supposed to depart – normally at any other airport in any other part of the world, this would have meant that we missed our flight. But upon arriving, sweating and short of breath from running to the check-in counter, they still let us check in!!! We were also upgraded to one of the seats in the front (without asking for it) of the plane and got personally escorted through security and walked to the gate by the kindest agent we have ever encountered. When we arrived at the gate, we noticed that they were still boarding and there was a small line when we arrived. We got on the plane and the massive 777 we were on was pretty empty and noticed that we were 2 of the 3 people seated in the front of the plane. It felt like we were flying private and it was wonderful. Sooner than we knew it, we were taking off and it was a short but comfortable flight to Osaka. While it was absolutely our fault that we were late (and we were very apologetic), we were incredibly impressed by their customer service and kindness. If I ever have the chance to fly Jin Air again, we absolutely will.
reviews.author: Richard Tamayo

reviews.title: PI trip 2/11-2/19/2020
reviews.text: Jin Air is a low-cost carrier, so I didn't expect too much. Since I purchased my ticket through Korean Air, I wasn't able to use their on-line check-in, had to do it the old fashioned way through the check-in counter. Going from Terminal 2 to Terminal 1 at ICN was a hassle, had to go through Immigration and Customs to catch a shuttle bus (found out later I could have taken a more-direct shuttle train). Jin Air has automated kiosks, but when I tried using one, it rejected me and I had to go check-in at the desk. Once at the gate, boarding was by the usual chaotic method, so if you're one of the last ones on, good luck on finding any bin space for your carry-on. Once at my seat, legroom was as expected for a low-cost carrier, but the seat was comfortable enough. No in-flight entertainment. The FAs were pleasant and efficient, always smiling. The aircraft and lavatories were tidy and well-maintained. Food was nothing to speak-of, but is edible.
reviews.author: Jerry

reviews.title: Bad online system
reviews.text: I want to open a complaint following what happened on Saturday 23 November 2019. I booked two tickets for me and my partner to fly from Macau to Seoul Incheon and whilst I was entering my data, your system won’t allow me to insert my full name, due to the blank space between the two names. For this reason, I insert the first name without my middle name and completed the whole process. But on the aforementioned date I went to the boarding check to drop my luggage and during the passport check, the operator told me that I won’t be able to embark the flight because of the name mismatch. And after that we went through a series of very unprofessional explanations about how your procedure work, that I had to cancel both mine and my partner ticket in order to book again the seats and how the price of a single ticket went up 6 to 7 timefolds and how to refund these tickets. In the end because of your system’s fault, I had to purchase a new ticket with a different airline and fly separately from my partner, with all the distress caused by this situation, also because I’m pregnant. This is one of the worst experience with an airline!
reviews.author: Shirley C

reviews.title: Flight Review Jin Air
reviews.text: reasonable low cost Airlines,Friendly Crew but the only thing given foc Luggage Allowance 15kg only.NO In-flight Entertainment
reviews.author: Steve Singkin Sini

reviews.title: Fun airline!
reviews.text: Crew were extremely kind and attentive throughout. The safety/emergency instructions booklet were illustrated with humorous comics making you actually enjoy reading them! Also, most budget airlines on a short flight offer nothing - sometimes you even pay for water. Jin Air will give you a small cup of tea if you ask for it~
reviews.author: Hashem A

reviews.title: Great discount airline!
reviews.text: JinAir is the best! We got very affordable tickets and in turn had low expectations. However they were great! We brought our bags on (2 bags each under 10kg) for free. Seated together for free. We even got food for free. Safe ride, great staff. Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Jackie

reviews.title: BEST LOW COST I EVER TRIED
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience with Jin-Air bound for Incheon. Check-in was superb and staff accommodated our request and assisted us the best way they could. Jin-Air being a low cost airline provided us with food and it was ok. Flight attendant was attentive to our needs and they are always smiling. flight was smooth overall. thanks Jin-Air
reviews.author: Tsino_suplado

reviews.title: Jin Air from Seoul to Cebu
reviews.text: Check in and boarding was good, staff were very friendly, but the seating as very uncomfortable the seats definitely require more padding and the leg room is very cramped. You are served with a glass of water and a decent size snack, you can also buy other drinks and snacks, the arrival cards and duty free declaration forms they hand out are almost illegible, .I think they are photo copies of photo copies, airline should consider change to better more illegible documents, no business class seats on this flight. No in flight entertainment, flight time is over 4 hours so unless you plan sleeping during the flight take a book or something to pass the time, if you are travelling with children you will definitely need something to keep them entertained.
reviews.author: WillRod321

reviews.title: Authantic and friendly staff
reviews.text: Hi use this for return flight for Shanghai-Jeju-Shanghai. My Jeju-Shanghai connection was cancelled. The staff at Jeju handled it very maturely. They were authentic and firm. They not offered any hotel or assistance, but very helpful booking hotel and negotiating as per specific need of customer. Next day morning - same staff was working after just 6 hour break for alternate flight. The staff really carry ownership above and beyond. Its budget airline but no-frill was not at all visible in their employees. Thank you for building my trust.
reviews.author: RATUSHAR

reviews.title: Best lowcost airline
reviews.text: We were surprised to receive free food and water which was a great surprise, the staff was friendly, check in easy, no issues with carry on baggages, flight had no delay. We would fly again and we recommend it
reviews.author: Monica M

reviews.title: Avoid at all cost
reviews.text: We attempted to book a flight from Naha Okinawa to Seoul; after entering all the data for the flight and each passenger the website basically crashed when I hit enter, after attempting it again and it failing, I gave up.. So I called the customer service/reservation desk, after about 45 minutes I had booked my tickets and had to pay an additional fee due to not using their website. I explained I tried using their website and would prefer a website vs calling international. But to no avail. I was told they did not accept my reservations on line due to not having a Korean credit card? Later the second individual said that is not correct. So I have no idea why the online app did not work. So we made hotel reservations and began planning our trip. Unfortunately (or fortunately) I received an email stating the return flight has been changed from Tuesday to Thursday??? Wow, so I checked on line and the flights all showed "SOLD OUT" so I called and was told they canceled the flight because not enough people had booked seats. I find this appalling, they sold us a product and should be obligated to provide it. It is amazing that they would cancel several daily flights, and possibly leave people stranded in Seoul for two days. I requested a refund and was given most of my money back. However they said they could not give back the ticketing fee for booking over the phone. Even though I did not want to book over the phone and had to due to their wanky website. So I ended up having to pay for ticketing that I canceled, along distance call as well as 1.5 hours between the two calls and website, and I got nothing. So, I booked a new flight on Peach, did no need to change any hotel reservation and am happy so far. I will never attempt to fly JinAir and would suggest avoiding it at all costs, if they can't run a website, reservation system or refund people's money, can they truly maintain aircraft? AVOID
reviews.author: gb64c

reviews.title: Excellent airline
reviews.text: I had an awsoem experience travelling on this airline. The staff are friendly and courteous! The flight itself was a good one. There was some turbulence, however, the pilot handled it like a pro, for the most part the ride was a smooth one. the seats are extremely comfortable and there is enough leg room. I definitely will be taking this airline again.
reviews.author: Angry Traveller

reviews.title: Not too bad LCC
reviews.text: As a LCC, it is not too bad as simple meal is included. No delay just a little turbulence but overall the experience is okay.
reviews.author: Bonnie S

reviews.title: Low Cost Korean Airlines
reviews.text: There was everything to like about Jin Air from the price of the flight to the service. Generous carry on allowance of 12kg. The time leaving from Osaka at 11am to arriving in Seoul at 1pm was quick and efficient. Loved the casual look of the flight attendants in their jeans and bright lime green shirts. Would recommend this as a flight from Japan to South Korea.
reviews.author: vagabondginger

reviews.title: Budget Airlines With First Class Service
reviews.text: This is my first time to fly with this airlines, it's an economy flight but free luggage loaded free for 15 kg. and free meal for everyone that I didn't notice before. The package are cute and good taste. If I have to fly to Korea again, this airlines will be in my list^^
reviews.author: UnWind

reviews.title: Budget airline pretty girls no food
reviews.text: There is no food on flight feel got cheated for domestic flight! But there is pretty korean air stewardess very polite and friendly much better than tway Stewardess! Feel excited to take flight back to Seoul to continue my trip
reviews.author: Dff

reviews.title: Good for a budget airline
reviews.text: Pros: - Free check-in bag and a light meal on-board (no options to choose from though - you get a box and your only option was either to eat it or not) - The cabin crew sported a smart casual look of shirt and jeans, and they looked happy/ energetic. Personally, I find that refreshing. Cons: - No online check-in. - The cabin crew on my flight didn't seem to have a very good command of English. I'm not sure I heard them say anything in English besides "seatbelt". I'd hate to imagine what would happen if there's an emergency or if they've to defuse a situation. - I could hardly hear the announcement made through the PA system, let alone what was being said. Might be a combination of loud engine noise and low PA volume
reviews.author: My2cents-101

reviews.title: The flight was a typical average budget friendly flight.  Nothing memorable and nothing to complain about.
reviews.text: Trying to understand which line to stand in to board the flight was a little confusing because Jinn Air and Jeju Air had the same line. The food and service was good. The seats were a little tight.
reviews.author: Vicki K

reviews.title: Flight from Tokyo to Kota Kinabalu via Incheon
reviews.text: Check-in staff at Tokyo and Incheon were excellent. Some staff (one male and female staff in particular) at Kota Kinabalu’s check-in counter were rude and put a sour note on an otherwise pleasant vacation. When the counters opened up for checking in, his sign said open so we went up, but as soon as we got up to the counter he shooed us away with his hand and told us he wasn’t open. I asked him which counter we should go and he rudely said, “I don’t know just go somewhere else.” The male staff two counters away called us over and was very polite and courteous. The difference in quality of service was shocking. I thank the male staff who checked us in for his kind and efficient service. The other guy needs some customer service training. The flight itself was not too bad. The seats, especially on the flight between Incheon and Kota Kinabalu, were cramped and a little bit uncomfortable, but I guess for LCC flights that can’t be helped. The flight attendants were friendly and attentive so that was much appreciated. It is highly likely we will fly Jin Air again in the future.
reviews.author: Mich

reviews.title: Budget, but free check in bags.
reviews.text: Not flown before, but what attracted me was the free 15 kg check in bags provided with the ticket. Jeju Air etc charges. Checkin was unusual, they had a special counter unly for flights to Busan and it was on the right side. Got it mixed up with the new counters opened further right. This special counter only opens 2hr before flight time. Comfort was ok, flight on time. Bags cleared fast.
reviews.author: Wei Min Ng

reviews.title: Pleasant Experience
reviews.text: Booked flight from Incheon/Kota Kinabalu with Jinair. Overall it was a pleasant experience right from the check in, ground staff are friendly, seat is comfortable, friendly crew on board. Would definitely book with Jinair again in future.
reviews.author: EvyAnthony

reviews.title: Not friendly staffs
reviews.text: Very cheap flight that doesn’t know how to treat passengers. Very rude and not friendly at all. The food is terrible too. Never will take this airline again.
reviews.author: Jennifer Y

reviews.title: Consistently meet or exceed my expectations!
reviews.text: Having made up to a dozen flights with Jin Air over the last 2-3 years, I suppose I have become somewhat of a 'frequent flyer' with the airline. Most of my previous flights with Jin Air have been relatively short hops of between 30-mins and 1-hour duration from South Korea to the Japanese mainland, but this longer 2-hour flight to the southernmost Ryukyu Islands was nonetheless equally satisfactory. A number of airlines offer budget flights from Busan to Okinawa and my selection of Jin Air was based on a number of factors including price and convenience. Whilst they continue to meet or exceed my expectations, they will continue to be my 1st choice on those routes.
reviews.author: Peter R.

reviews.title: Flight to Korea
reviews.text: Friendly steward and stewardess...The flight to Korea was a bit hot inside the airplane...however, flying from Korea back to our country was great.
reviews.author: Scenic35434871042

reviews.title: A lovely airline
reviews.text: Another lovely Asian airline, so the service was amazing as well as the food served. The crew was very kind and professional. Really enjoyed the flight. Also the check-in was smooth and simply perfect.
reviews.author: IvanaM2363

reviews.title: Avoid this airline at all costs
reviews.text: I booked a flight a couple of days ago for around 8pm. All flight for this day where very similarly priced but I thought I would be spending some time in Seoul throughout the day. My plans changed and I arrived at airport at 1pm and asked them to move me onto earlier flight if they had availability. They informed me I would have to cancel my reservation and make s new reservation which is ridiculous. They had a half empty flight leaving within the hour and was not willing to move me forward with a charge that was the equivalent of 6 times more than the price of the flight 2 days ago!!! I discussed with the manager at the airline who tried to convince me this is normal and that all airlines do it but this is not true as I have flown with many airlines and had this happen in the past. It makes sense for the customer happiness and also for buisness sense as the flight that leaves in an hour will have empty seats which cannot be sold. They could then have 5-6 hours longer to sell my original seat!! Lack of customer service and buisness sense. I have used Jin air a couple of times and I will not use this flight operator again.
reviews.author: Gavin O

reviews.title: Smooth flight
reviews.text: We booked our flight to Jeju online with Jin Air after doing our research. Lots of budget airlines flying to and from Jeju everyday but Jin Air seemed to have the best deals then. Booking and checking in online was easy. However since we had two children we, had to check them in at the counter in Gimpo and Jeju Airport. The staff at the counter and onboard were pleasant and friendly. Only thing is that they are very slow in answering queries via emails. However, they are a good airline to fly with.
reviews.author: Speis75

reviews.title: Very pleasant
reviews.text: An economy airline with very high standards of its staff. Check-in and on-board teams were pleasant, helpful, professional and efficient. They went out if their way to solve a connection problem and, were thoroughly pleasant to deal with. If l have to find a negative... it would be the casual dress code for cabin crew. Difficult to discern them from passengers and, as safety is their prime role... they lost some impact. Very impressed with JinAir. I highly recommend them. The Best budget carrier l have flown with.
reviews.author: WalkingPoint

reviews.title: Pleasant budget airline
reviews.text: Now days there are many options for flying to Jeju. Jin air has competitive rates and friendly service. I haven't flown international with them yet. It isno frills and pay for extras but no complaints otherwise.
reviews.author: Soonjin P

reviews.title: Lovely experience
reviews.text: The attendants are smiley and helpful. Food is delicious, though we only had simple cold snacks. Great budget airline!
reviews.author: theliving2D

reviews.title: Outstanding Service!
reviews.text: Outstanding Exceptional Service! I am a United Airlines lifetime Global Services member (highest level) and flew Jin Air from Seoul to Narita. While there was a modest delay in the departure and because my original connecting time was 1 hour at Narita Terminal 1, I informed the flight attendants. To make sure that I made my connecting flight, they arranged for me to sit in an empty front row middle seat and made room for my luggage, and helped me get my luggage ready when we landed. The courteous, resourcefulness, and solution oriented plan helped me make my tight connection without any problem. It was one of the best service that I have ever received. I have flown millions of miles with many different airlines including the top airlines in Asia and Europe. Thank you Jin Air for the superb service!
reviews.author: Very Pleased Customer!

reviews.title: Rather uncomfortable flight
reviews.text: The seats are not spaced well and it wasn’t easy to take a nap during the flight. The price is reasonable but if you are willing to take a domestic flight in Korea, you may consider that Jin Air doesn’t always offer the best price.
reviews.author: John_K15125

reviews.title: Don't waste your time
reviews.text: Utterly rubbish, their website gave us so many problems and their call center is not very helpful either, steer clear.!
reviews.author: eonw83

reviews.title: easy to book and fly. low base fare, watch out for added fees.
reviews.text: jin air wasn't the cheapest option from nrt to icn but the website was (english!) user friendly so i ended up booking with them. just be sure to turn pop up blocker off otherwise payment won't go through properly. base fare was reasonable. where they get you is added fees for seat choice, baggage, and meal options. carry on, personal item, and checked bag up to 15kg included in fare. extra 10kg was 47 USD, 15kg was 62 USD. opted out of pricey meals, which ended up being ok thanks to convenience store snacks and the little snack provided by jin air! don't recall the charge to choose a seat but i believe it was minimal. boarding process was interesting in that there was no announcement made at the gate; people just started lining up at the boarding time stated on the boarding pass, so pay attention! in all, a good first experience with a korean budget airline! i'd book with jin air again.
reviews.author: Navigator789132

reviews.title: Good airline
reviews.text: Nothing special, but I reviewed most airlines and prices and seemed this was the cheapest and had the best website to book! Recommend if travelling to jeju
reviews.author: Zack

reviews.title: Low Cost Carrier from Seoul to Bangkok - Jin Air
reviews.text: My first time to fly Jin Air for my trip from Seoul to Bangkok round trip. Reasonable fare and didn't have high expectations. Flight attendants were very hospitable and attentive to passenger needs. Cabin was clean and all that - not much different from other airlines. In-flight meals were obviously not as good, and didn't finish them... Maybe for Jin Air to re-think what to do with it. All in all, I liked Jin Air given it's reasonable pricing. Recommend for others to try it out.
reviews.author: JewooCha

reviews.title: Better budget
reviews.text: We took a different carrier on our way to Okinawa and this return flight was much more comfortable. Not to mention they have us water and snacks, which my children were thrilled about.
reviews.author: Cindy B

reviews.title: Comfort flying experinece
reviews.text: The stewardess is good in serving the customers food , beverages ... at the same time the pilot are excellent with their flying skills as we have a non interrupted nap within 4 hours plus flight . Definitely will travel again with the airline
reviews.author: chua h

reviews.title: Uncomfortable seats
reviews.text: Yes, it is one of LCC. You'd better expect efficiency than comfort. but, when considering the price, the seat was uncomfortable, crews are quite not helpful in many ways. I cannot say they are competent when thinking of many LCCs these days.
reviews.author: yanggiman

reviews.title: Consider Jin Air
reviews.text: The website is a little different, so I had hesitated, but the price couldn’t be beat, so I crossed my fingers and purchased my flight with Jin Air. I’m glad I did! The personnel was courteous and all I encountered spoke perfectly good English. If you’re looking for business or first class seats then this is not the airline for you. The entire plane is economy seating. For a short 3 hour flight from Tokyo to Seoul, check-in baggage is included and a light snack/meal. I highly recommend it.
reviews.author: Les L

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: I had never travelled with this airline. So I booked a return between Seoul and Tokyo for a work trip. I'm not a regular traveller with budget airlines so my expectations were low. But the whole experience was not bad at all. For a budget airline they gave you a small snack box which was a nice touch. The crew were extremely friendly and helpful. My only qualm would be the legroom. (I will add that I'm over 6ft) It was a squeeze on the outbound. But I requested an exit seat on the return and that was far better.
reviews.author: Gareth B

reviews.title: Totally satisfied with all aspects of the service
reviews.text: Having previously flown Jin Air on a number of routes from Busan, Korea to Guam, Okinawa and Osaka, they were my first choice when I was looking for a likely destination for a few days away, at a good price. This time I selected the 30-minute hop to Kitakyushu in Japan; was totally satisfied with all aspects of the (albeit brief) service, and it was steal at $70 each way. I particularly liked the choice of seat price based on the amount of luggage carried, seat location, extra legroom, etc. On such a short hop, who needs the extra frills?
reviews.author: Peter R.

reviews.title: terrible service
reviews.text: its for sure the worst service i have ever got in a flight. i was delyed during the check in with no reason i can tell about ( and the staff dont speak any english). after that i was taken to another room just to meet another staff member that asked me to take out things from my baggage and as well spoke only korean. it is cheap indeed, but not enough fir this expirience.
reviews.author: ido z

reviews.title: Catch their Promotion plan
reviews.text: I caught a Osaka tour for only 100 dollars.It was so good that I could spend the rest of the money to enjoy my trip in Osaka.Economy seats don't seem to be a problem when the distance of flight is short.
reviews.author: Yeonho S

reviews.title: great value for money!
reviews.text: Great value for money, good deal in Easter holiday which includes baggage, light meal and good services. although online check is not worked for me, i did finished check in in counter quickly especially in Seoul Airport. around 10 counters were opened. Staff are cheerful and helpful. its surprising to see their causal but energetic uniform. I would choose Jin Air again.
reviews.author: VickyVickyC

reviews.title: Flight from Da Nang to Seoul
reviews.text: Not much to expect from this flight, a short trip from Da Nang to Seoul before heading home to SFO. However, it started off nicely with welcomed greetings as you would expect but then I cut my finger pretty bad loading up our carry on bags. The flight attendant was quick to provide a bandage but also she came back with ointment and applied it herself along with wrapping the bandage. I guess I was surprised by this as I would have been used to just being handed the first aid back in the states. However, the most surprising thing and what was very nice was the airlines understanding that my father and I were needing to connect to our flight back to SFO. Our connection time was a bit short so they informed us as we were about to land that someone would greet us outside the plane (literally outside the plane) and escort us to the Transfer Ticket station (Korean Air). This ended up being a life safer as my father is 71 and uses a cane to walk around, Terminal 2 of Incheon is a very large and having the Jin Air escort likely saved us around 25-30 minutes of additional walking/waiting to gain bearings, etc. Very happy with the customer service shown by this air line and it's staff.
reviews.author: Jon
